hold_text: This PR adds research/queue/RQ-20260927-002.yaml and research/queue/RQ-20260927-003.yaml as NEW files -- pre-registered decision rules -- which STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE and TIER1_SURFACE both correctly refuse to vouch for, same precedent as PR #13046's w5d-rq007-oos.json ('registering a decision rule is exactly the act R5/E57's own comment says must hold for a human'). Every other changed path (research/results/**, scripts/research/**, docs/claude/work/pipeline/**, .github/**) is inside TIER1_SURFACE and would self-land cleanly on its own. This is Tier-1 research work -- no config/, src/, or live order-path file is touched, no exit-head artifact or gate is changed -- held only because the guard correctly cannot certify a brand-new decision-rule file as a stamp.
why: Wave-6 lane M2: (1) RQ-20260927-002 registers and (once the dispatched trainer-vm-diag run lands) reports a 3-fold embargoed walk-forward extension of RQ-20260927-001's single-split recovered_R_oos, with a committed reusable driver (scripts/research/exit_head_walkforward_multifold.py) rather than a one-off uncommitted payload. (2) RQ-20260927-003 registers and (once its dispatched run lands) reports an exit-head-for-prop-legs swap feasibility look (trend_donchian_sol_prop / trend_donchian_eth_prop), scoping whether a real per-leg retrain is worth doing. (3) Updates PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0001 (twin-dedup mirror divergence) to state=routed, pointing at the held Tier-2 fix PR #13076 (branch claude/w6-exit-head-twin-dedup-fix) -- that fix ships as its OWN PR/branch, not on this one, per the Tier-2 permission gate. No config, artifact-stage, or live-path change on this branch; promotion itself stays Tier-3 and is not decided here.
